title: Checkout API degraded-service investigation
guidance: Compare error-rate onset with recent deployments.
Check connection counts before and after deployment.
Review traces for timeout or connection-acquisition failures.
Compare configuration with the previous known-good release.
caution: Runbook guidance suggests investigation steps; it does not establish root cause.

title: Catalog API health investigation
guidance: Inspect request latency and error-rate trends.
caution: Runbook guidance is operational guidance, not incident evidence.
